subject: Operations
title: Strategic Partnerships
description: A quick win: understand Strategic Partnerships.

hook.text: Toyota doesn't just buy parts from suppliers. It sends engineers to help them improve. That's a partnership, not a deal.

buildup.text: Strategic partnerships go beyond purchasing—they involve shared goals, joint investment, and mutual improvement.

discovery.text: Partners share risk, develop capabilities together, and create value that neither could achieve alone.

twist.text: Partnerships require trust and transparency. Without them, the relationship degrades into adversarial negotiation.

climax.text: Apple and TSMC co-invest billions in chip technology. Neither could push performance boundaries alone.

punchline.text: The best supplier isn't a vendor. It's a partner.

quiz.question: What distinguishes a strategic partnership from a regular purchase?
